name: Kouman Tsuma Kanraku!!! ~Ii Onna Dakedo Ya na Onna~
original_name: 高慢妻陥落！！！～イイ女だけどヤな女～
source:
The protagonist is having a hard time at work.

His superior, Kyouka, is a prideful woman with an arrogant attitude towards male employees. She especially dislikes the protagonist, so she's always making things difficult for him.

"You haven't finished the report yet!?"
"Haven't you learned anything in college!?"
"You are an adult, you have to be responsible!!"
"Geez...men are always making excuses, that's why I hate them!!"

But one day, the protagonist discovers a secret about Kyouka that will change everything.

[Loosely Translated from [url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_171592/?dmmref=DetailOtherWorks&i3_ref=recommend&i3_ord=1]DMM[/url]]
translation:
主人公在职场上过得很不顺心。

他的上司京香自尊心极强，对男员工总是一副傲慢的态度。她尤其讨厌主人公，总是处处刁难他。

“报告还没写完？！”
“你在大学里到底学了些什么？！”
“你已经是成年人了，要有点责任心！！”
“真是的……男人总是在找借口，所以我才讨厌你们！！”

然而有一天，主人公发现了京香的一个秘密，而这将改变一切。

[意译自[url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_171592/?dmmref=DetailOtherWorks&i3_ref=recommend&i3_ord=1]DMM[/url]]
